items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX, Tesla to Build Chip Plant in Texas to Meet Compute Demand
items.summary_cn: SpaceX与Tesla将在德州合资建芯片厂以满足算力需求——直接利好SpaceX/SPCX，并间接触及SK海力士等AI半导体供应链。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX makes Terafab official, confirms initial $16.8 billion investment
items.summary_cn: SpaceX正式官宣Terafab项目，初始投资168亿美元——利好SpaceX及AI/半导体供应链。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX to invest $16.8bn in Texas TeraFab as Elon Musk says 100m-sq-ft fab will be “50 times the size of the Pentagon”
items.summary_cn: Musk确认SpaceX将在德州TeraFab投资168亿美元，规模号称'50倍五角大楼'——利好SpaceX。

items.author: Musk
items.text: ‘Pure insanity’—Elon Musk details SpaceX’s plan to turn the moon into its newest manufacturing site
items.summary_cn: Musk披露SpaceX计划将月球改造为生产基地——利好SpaceX及航天板块。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk reveals SpaceX plans to build satellite factories on the moon
items.summary_cn: Musk透露SpaceX计划在月球建造卫星工厂——利好SpaceX及航天板块长期叙事。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk repeatedly one-upped his execs on SpaceX’s first earnings call
items.summary_cn: SpaceX首次财报电话会，Musk多次压过自家高管——强化SpaceX估值叙事，利好SPCX。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX Bought $295 Million Worth Of Tesla Megapacks In Q2
items.summary_cn: SpaceX Q2斥资2.95亿美元采购Tesla Megapacks——强化Tesla储能业务收入及SpaceX资本开支逻辑。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Trump allies push to arm president with new tariff weapon to punish countries 'ripping off' America: https://www.foxnews.com/politics/trump-allies-push-arm-president-new-tariff-weapon-punish-countries-ripping-off-america
items.summary_cn: Trump盟友推动赋予总统新关税武器，惩罚'占美国便宜'的国家——关税升级信号。

items.author: Trump
items.text: The U.S. has massive amounts of “munitions,” especially of certain types. Additionally, large amounts are being manufactured and shipped to the U.S. as needed. Defense companies are building the largest number of plants and factories in our country’s history. The “leakers” of these treasonous statements are being hunted down. Long term jail sentences will be sought! President DJT
items.summary_cn: Trump称美国弹药充足、国防企业正兴建史上最多工厂——利好国防军工板块。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk’s DOGE made big errors in claims of government savings, GAO finds
items.summary_cn: GAO报告称Musk的DOGE在政府节省金额上存在重大错误——对Musk/DOGE形象负面，但市场含义有限。
